name: oai-chat-persistence
description: Persistent, multi-session AI chat sidebar that works ON your workspace: the model reads, searches and edits your files through approved diffs. Works with Ollama, Copilot and any VS Code language model.

oaiChatPersistence.defaultModel.description: Default VS Code language model ID to pre-select for new sessions (e.g. ollama:llama3.2). Leave blank to pick manually.

oaiChatPersistence.contextWindowTokens.description: Estimated token threshold that triggers automatic context compaction before each request. Uses the ~4 chars/token heuristic. Set to 0 to disable auto-compaction.

oaiChatPersistence.compactionKeepMessage.description: Number of most-recent messages to keep verbatim after compaction. Older messages are replaced by an AI-generated summary.

oaiChatPersistence.defaultAgentMode.description: Start new sessions in agent mode, where the model may edit workspace files (each change is still approved by you). Turn off for read-only sessions.

oaiChatPersistence.enableWriteTools.description: Expose the write_file / edit_file / delete_file tools to the model. Disable to make every session read-only.

enumDescriptions: Show a diff in the chat and wait for Apply / Reject on every change.
Apply edits immediately (still undoable with Ctrl+Z); deletions and shell commands always ask.
oaiChatPersistence.editApproval.description: How workspace changes requested by the model are confirmed.

oaiChatPersistence.enableTerminalTool.description: Let the model run shell commands in the workspace root (tests, builds, git). Every command requires explicit approval and is never auto-approved.

oaiChatPersistence.includeEditorContext.description: Append a one-line note about the active file, cursor line and selection to each message you send.

oaiChatPersistence.maxToolRounds.description: Maximum number of tool-call rounds the model may take in a single reply.

oaiChatPersistence.maxFileBytes.description: Maximum number of bytes of a file handed to the model by the read_file tool.

oaiChatPersistence.allowWritesOutsideWor.description: Permit edits to files outside the open workspace folders. Off by default.

oaiChatPersistence.ollamaHost.description: Base URL of the Ollama server for direct local model communication.

oaiChatPersistence.ollamaContextWindow.description: Context window (num_ctx) sent to Ollama for local model requests.

oaiChatPersistence.enableGitTools.description: Expose dedicated git tools (git_status, git_diff, git_log, git_commit) to the model.

scripts.lint: node --check src/extension.js && node --check src/panel.js && node --check src/lm.js && node --check src/tools.js && node --check src/workspace.js && node --check src/storage.js
